material_state.hydrodynamic_frame: Landau two-fluid local rest frame; normal-component shear channel

coefficient.recommended_row_locator: Donnelly and Barenghi (1998), Table 12.3, T90=1.70 K
coefficient.source_caution: The review states that absolute viscosity accuracy is hard to evaluate; this package therefore uses the local adopted-database envelope as a conservative bound, not as a one-standard-deviation estimate.

primary_source.title: The Observed Properties of Liquid Helium at the Saturated Vapor Pressure

correlator_contract.formula: eta = V/(k_B T) integral_0^infinity dt <delta_Pi_xy(t) delta_Pi_xy(0)>
correlator_contract.kms_fdt: G_K^(xy,xy)=coth(hbar omega/(2 k_B T)) (G_R-G_A); low-frequency shear-noise amplitude is 2 k_B T eta
correlator_contract.entropy_mapping: nabla_mu J_S^mu contains 2 eta sigma_mu_nu sigma^mu_nu/T >= 0

primary_linear_response_source.title: Statistical-Mechanical Theory of Irreversible Processes. I
primary_linear_response_source.author: Ryogo Kubo

preprocessing: Direct transcription of the 1.70 K recommended viscosity row and the two nearest 1.7039 K adopted-database rows. No fit, interpolation, target-curve use, or UET parameter tuning.
claim_boundary: This source-locks one physical SI shear-viscosity coefficient for the normal component of He II at the declared SVP state and connects it to a standard stress Kubo/FDT/entropy channel. It is an external transport input, not a UET prediction, not a bulk Fourier heat conductivity, and not a complete two-fluid transport tensor.
